name: CSRD applicability rule sets — versioned
description: Deterministic rule sets that decide whether a company is in scope of the EU Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive. Rules are data, not code: a regulatory change is a new or amended entry here, never an engine rewrite. Every rule carries a legal status and a source; entries whose status is not 'in_force' are reported as such and never silently applied.
honesty_note: Applicability output is a screening determination, not legal advice. Borderline cases are returned as 'requires_legal_confirmation'.

status_vocabulary.adopted_pending_application: Adopted but pending scrutiny period, official publication, or a future application date. Reported, not applied.
status_vocabulary.proposed: Legislative proposal only. Never applied; shown for forward planning.

rule_sets.name: CSRD (EU) 2022/2464 as adopted — original thresholds
rule_sets.source: Directive (EU) 2022/2464; Accounting Directive size thresholds as updated by Delegated Directive (EU) 2023/2775

eu_undertaking.note: Large undertaking = meets at least 2 of 3 size criteria. Wave 1 (public-interest >500 employees, already under NFRD) reports from FY2024.

non_eu_undertaking.note: Art. 40a: non-EU companies with > €150M net turnover in the EU for two consecutive financial years and at least one EU branch or subsidiary.

rule_sets.name: Omnibus I package — proposed scope restriction

eu_undertaking.note: Proposal: only undertakings with >1000 employees AND (turnover > €50M OR balance sheet > €25M) remain in scope; listed SMEs removed; value-chain cap limits data requests to companies below 1000 employees to the VSME voluntary standard. NOT applied by the engine — reported for forward planning only.

non_eu_undertaking.note: Proposal raises the EU turnover threshold to €450M; kept at the in-force value here and flagged in output.

rule_sets.name: VSME — voluntary sustainability reporting standard for non-listed SMEs
rule_sets.source: EFRAG VSME standard; Commission recommendation on voluntary reporting for SMEs
rule_sets.note: Voluntary standard for companies below CSRD thresholds. Doubles as the value-chain cap: in-scope companies may not demand information from smaller value-chain partners beyond what VSME covers.
